Class Station

java.lang.Object
domain.Station
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Station extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a Station within a map, now including orientation.

  • Constructor Details

    • Station

      public Station(Station.Type type, String name, String mapName, String scenarioName, String ownerPlayer, int price, int capacity, int x, int y, Station.Orientation orientation)
      Constructs a new Station with the specified attributes.
      Parameters:
      type - the type of the station (DEPOT, STATION, TERMINAL)
      name - the name of the station
      mapName - the name of the map where the station is located
      scenarioName - the scenario associated with the station
      ownerPlayer - the name of the owner of the station
      price - the price of the station
      capacity - the maximum cargo capacity of the station
      x - the x-coordinate of the station's location
      y - the y-coordinate of the station's location
      orientation - the orientation of the station (NE, SE, NW, SW) if the type is STATION
